excerpt: Job Hunting in Canada in 2026: Why Sending 100 Applications Isn’t the Strategy Anymore Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. The Spray-and-Pray Era Is Over For a brief window after the pandemic, the Canadian job market rewarded almost anyone willing to apply. Employers were desperate. Vacancies outnumbered candidates. You could send a generic resume to twenty companies and hear back from twelve. 2026 is different. Canada’s unemployment rate reached 6.8% by the end of 2025, according to Statistics Canada’s Labour Force Survey. More people are actively looking for work
